needed.evidence: The left side has a wide paved area under the overpass, but it is used for parking and has construction materials, making it an informal path rather than a safe
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, raised sidewalk on the left side, separated from the parking area by a physical barrier.

needed.evidence: The left footway is obstructed by parked cars and construction materials, blocking the path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Remove the parked cars and construction materials from the left footway to clear the path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to shops and a bus stop on the right, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible in the 100m segment.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at the junction with the side road to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The road is in an urban area with commercial buildings, but there are no street lights visible along the carriageway in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users at night.
